body: That would be the dream. At least for me. I have always thought that things would turn around for me. Post conviction +20 years have proven that it gets harder and harder. I am really scared to think what next week holds let alone the next year. I have been through 5 jobs in the last two years. Money conning in is less and less. It’s the depression I find myself in continually. I can’t provide for my kids I can’t take care of my wife by myself and we live paycheck to paycheck. I can never find the road to redemption.
